# CURL for Windows

```
curl ^"https://api.coachless.gg/api/Rune/GetShardsForKeystoneAndTree^" ^
  -H ^"Accept: application/json, text/plain, */*^" ^
  -H ^"Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9^" ^
  -H ^"Authorization: Bearer null^" ^
  -H ^"Connection: keep-alive^" ^
  -H ^"Content-Type: application/json^" ^
  -H ^"Origin: https://www.coachless.gg^" ^
  -H ^"Referer: https://www.coachless.gg/^" ^
  -H ^"Sec-Fetch-Dest: empty^" ^
  -H ^"Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors^" ^
  -H ^"Sec-Fetch-Site: same-site^" ^
  -H ^"User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/146.0.0.0 Safari/537.36^" ^
  -H ^"sec-ch-ua: ^\^"Chromium^\^";v=^\^"146^\^", ^\^"Not-A.Brand^\^";v=^\^"24^\^", ^\^"Google Chrome^\^";v=^\^"146^\^"^" ^
  -H ^"sec-ch-ua-mobile: ?0^" ^
  -H ^"sec-ch-ua-platform: ^\^"Windows^\^"^" ^
  --data-raw ^"^{^\^"keystone^\^":null,^\^"commonFilters^\^":^{^\^"patch^\^":^{^\^"major^\^":16,^\^"patch^\^":16,^\^"patchAdditions^\^":0^},^\^"championIds^\^":^[64^],^\^"matchupChampionIds^\^":null,^\^"leagueTiers^\^":^[4,5,6,7^],^\^"regions^\^":null,^\^"role^\^":1^}^}^"
```
